question: Can one frozen eight-state residual realization predict within-task and cross-task causal effects for temporal and is/was upstream commands under both tasks' downstream readouts?

frozen_finite_realization.state_basis: The orthonormal resid18 basis S obtained by mapping temporal H3-Q8 through the real c_proj and residual gain.
frozen_finite_realization.temporal_commands: First eight jointly capable v11 A1 and first eight A2 rows. Reconstruct each frozen causal-suffix H3-Q8 response and express its residual write in S coordinates.
frozen_finite_realization.iswas_commands: First four rows from each of v2 A1, v2 A2, v3 A1, and v3 A2. Use the temporal-Q8 projection of each released cDAS residual write, expressed in S coordinates.
frozen_finite_realization.downstream_readouts: Use the same 32 base resid18 contexts with each row's donor-answer minus donor-foil margin. Compute the exact analytic derivative through final RMS normalization, unembedding, and softcap in S coordinates.
frozen_finite_realization.causal_matrix: H_exact[i,j] is the actual margin change when source command i is added to target context j. H_pred=C R^T is the zero-fit eight-state prediction. Report temporal->temporal, temporal->iswas, iswas->temporal, and iswas->iswas quadrants separately.
frozen_finite_realization.controls: A seeded source-row permutation must materially worsen global prediction. Report the rank-eight SVD energy of H_exact and the numerical ranks/singular spectra of C, R, and H_pred.

predictions.pred_a_exact_authority_state_constructio: All source-factor closure, capture/head identity, weight orientation, matrix shape, finite-value, and price controls pass.
predictions.pred_b_one_q8_realization_predicts_all_f: Every quadrant has prediction/exact cosine at least 0.90 and relative RMSE at most 0.30.
predictions.pred_c_finite_matrix_is_effectively_eigh: Rank-eight SVD captures at least 90% of H_exact squared Frobenius energy; H_pred numerical rank is at most eight; both command and reader matrices have at least four singular values above 1e-3 of their largest.
predictions.pred_d_cross_task_quadrants_are_observab: Each cross-task quadrant's exact RMS is at least 10% of the geometric mean of the two within-task RMS values.
predictions.pred_e_coordinate_pairing_beats_shuffled: Global prediction cosine exceeds a seeded source-row-permuted prediction by at least 0.20.

decision: A pass identifies a finite shared causal state on this command/readout family, with empirical state dimension bounded between four and eight. It does not prove the infinite Hankel/Fliess assumptions or a globally minimal transformer realization.
